points: The page contradicts itself on roles: the checkboxes (and gold) mark the owners as 10% holders, with Kilgore as officer 'SEE REMARKS'.
The Remarks say Kilgore is Executive Chairman and a director, and Cody Smith is COO and a director -- neither is_director in gold.
Script check: all 1 transaction row(s) match the page field by field (date, code, shares, A/D, price, owned-after, D/I, table).
4 line(s) without a date/code are holdings, correctly left out of the gold.
5 reporting owners; their box-5 checkboxes match the gold.

suggest.note: Box 5 checkboxes vs Remarks disagree on director/officer roles for Kilgore and Smith.
